card.summary: Competitive grant for deep-tech commercialisation with a POC cap of SGD 400,000 and a POV cap of SGD 800,000, both raised on 2 January 2025 from SGD 250,000 ...

free_tier.stated: Competitive grant for deep-tech commercialisation with a POC cap of SGD 400,000 and a POV cap of SGD 800,000, both raised on 2 January 2025 from SGD 250,000 and SGD 500,000. The grant carries an equity component: Enterprise Singapore holds the right to subscribe to shares, and paid-up capital of 10 percent of the POC grant or 20 percent of the POV grant must be shown before award.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: The 30 percent local-ownership rule is what makes this hard to compose: a foreign founder must bring a Singaporean or PR shareholder holding a third of the company before the SGD 800,000 becomes visible, which is a different cost from the capital contribution the grant asks for.

limits.value: The applicant must be 'Registered in Singapore within the past 10 years', must have 'at least 30% local equity held directly or indirectly by Singaporean(s) and/or Singapore PR(s)', and must carry out 'Core R&D activities ... in Singapore', so a foreign founder with no Singaporean shareholder fails the ownership test before the project is read.

evidence.proved: 'The grant cap for POC will remain at SGD400,000'; 'the grant cap for POC projects has been raised from the previous cap of SGD250,000 to SGD400,000', quoted
'The grant cap for POV will remain at SGD800,000'; raised 'from the previous cap of SGD500,000', quoted
'Company has at least 30% local equity held directly or indirectly by Singaporean(s) and/or Singapore PR(s), determined by the ultimate individual ownership', quoted

'Registered in Singapore within the past 10 years at time of grant application'; 'Core R&D activities to be carried out in Singapore'; 'Company is not a subsidiary of a corporate entity at point of incorporation', quoted
'startups will be required to demonstrate existing paid-up capital equivalent to at least 10% of the POC grant' and '20% of the POV grant', quoted
'the grant will also carry an equity component where Enterprise Singapore will have the rights to exercise a share subscription', quoted, page last updated 2025-09-18

record.notes: Three gates were considered. (a) Singapore incorporation: confirmed, but it is the cheapest of the three and a foreigner can incorporate a Pte Ltd without a resident director only by appointing a nominee. (b) Local shareholding of 30 percent: confirmed, and this is the binding one, because it is an ownership test rather than a registration step. (c) A paid-up capital requirement: confirmed at 10 or 20 percent of the grant, which for the POV cap is SGD 160,000 that must exist before award, so the grant is really a matching instrument. The 'artificial intelligence (e.g. deep learning)' line under Information & Communications Technologies is the only sub-area that names AI directly, so a project must be framed inside one of the five listed areas to qualify at all.
